title: Labeling Project counter deltas
$comment: Fixed caller-transactional counter updates. Functions perform only the corresponding Labeling counter fields and updated_at write; actor policy and commit remain with the caller.

functions.semantics: Execute one UPDATE of review_tasks = GREATEST(COALESCE(review_tasks, 0) - 1, 0) and updated_at = now() for the matching Project. A matched row is updated even when the counter is already at zero. SQL NULL input executes the UPDATE and matches zero rows, returning SQL NULL like a missing Project. The attempted UPDATE is still rejected in a read-only transaction. Native int32 overflow propagates as PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22003. The UPDATE uses normal row-update waiting. No actor checks, extra locks, other writes, or commit are added; the caller owns the surrounding transaction.

Execute one UPDATE of completed_tasks = GREATEST(COALESCE(completed_tasks, 0) - 1, 0) and updated_at = now() for the matching Project. A matched row is updated even when the counter is already at zero. SQL NULL input executes the UPDATE and matches zero rows, returning SQL NULL like a missing Project. The attempted UPDATE is still rejected in a read-only transaction. Native int32 overflow propagates as PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22003. The UPDATE uses normal row-update waiting. No actor checks, extra locks, other writes, or commit are added; the caller owns the surrounding transaction.

Execute one UPDATE of completed_tasks = COALESCE(completed_tasks, 0) + 1, review_tasks = GREATEST(COALESCE(review_tasks, 0) - 1, 0), and updated_at = now() for the matching Project. SQL NULL input executes the UPDATE and matches zero rows, like a missing Project. The attempted UPDATE is still rejected in a read-only transaction. Native int32 overflow propagates as PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22003. The UPDATE uses normal row-update waiting. No actor checks, extra locks, other writes, or commit are added; the caller owns the surrounding transaction.

native_integer_overflow.translation: None; PostgreSQL integer overflow propagates to the caller.
